text:
mira: Heads-up — brought nova-ceres16b-int4 onto canary; getting sporadic OOMs at long tail (>700 tokens).

sam: saw that. Pattern: mem spike post-kv-evict then OOM. log: `OOM cuda:1 | kv_evictions=9 | slab_frag=0.78`.

jin: hypothesis: quant kernel fallback for certain head counts creates large temp buffers. Could be attention kernel path.

mira: repro on local harness with 15 concurrent sessions; ~30% OOM within 4m.

sam: quick config test: batch=4,microbatch=2,max_new_tokens=512 removed OOMs in smoke.

jin: propose canary defaults change: batch_size=4, microbatch=2, max_new_tokens=512, slot_compaction=soft, kv_prefetch=true.

deploy-bot: deploy 6300001234-nova-ceres-canary v2 started

mira: will run 8h soak, collect OOM count, kv_eviction_rate, tail latency. abort on >2 OOMs/hr.

sam: +1. also run 1k evals to check quality drift.

jin: if still flaky, plan B: pin last block to int8 or disable the fallback matmul; that trades latency but may stabilize.
